title: Choose CardPulse's new visual world
question: The roll assigned Proof Sheet. Keep it, take the pick, adopt a declined card, or re-roll.

options.label: Proof Sheet
options.lineage: The visiting-card printer's prepress proof: crop marks, imposition grids, registration, type specimens
options.thesis: Every card you collect lands on today's proof sheet; the app is the press room, not a filing cabinet.
materials: hairline crop marks only at real card corners
imposition grid at the card's own 1.75:1 ratio
tabular specimen numerals for proof numbers and dates
options.viewport: Home is today's sheet: the latest cards imposed two-up with crop marks, each tagged with its proof number and next follow-up; one dense line of counts above; Scan is a full-width bar at the thumb.
options.risk: Crop marks become costume if they appear anywhere a card is not; they may only mark real card edges, including the camera's detected corners.

raised.raise: Every screen measures against one grid: a 4px baseline and the 1.75:1 card module set every row, tile and gap.
Palette law: proof red means due or overdue and nothing else; registration cyan means live or tappable and nothing else.
Every contact carries a proof number (event code and sequence, e.g. PLAST26 · 014) set in tabular figures, so a hall's haul can be counted and cited.
One accent is one control: Scan is the only filled accent object on any screen.
Selection inverts: a selected row or card turns press-black with white type, never a tint.
A contact moves through named phases (New, Contacted, Follow-up, Done), each with a label and a mark, never colour alone.

options.label: Trading Desk
options.lineage: Indian trading apps (Kite, Groww): watchlists, tickers, dense numeric rows
options.thesis: Your contacts as a watchlist: dense rows with the next action and days-to-follow-up at the right edge, checked as often as a portfolio.
materials: a thin ticker of today's figures
options.viewport: Home is a ticker of today's numbers over a watchlist of people due, each row name, company, phase and a days count; Scan is the one filled button.
options.risk: Familiar: close to many fintech and dashboard apps; distinct from Covve, but not unique.

options.label: Oscilloscope Bench
options.lineage: CRT oscilloscope on a signal bench
options.thesis: The 'pulse' of your network drawn as a trace on an etched graticule.
options.viewport: A green follow-up trace over a ten-division grid.
options.case: Fuses on the name only: a business person in a hall does not read a waveform, and phosphor on black fights daylight.
options.kept: Everything is measured against one grid.

options.label: Starship Terminal
options.thesis: Contacts as a ship's log printed line by line.
options.viewport: A typed query line answering in green capitals.
options.case: Reads as costume, not professional; slow typed output fights 'fewest taps'.
options.kept: Stenciled codes on every zone, which became proof numbers.

options.label: Arcade Cabinet
options.viewport: A pixel scoreboard of cards captured.
options.case: Loses both axes: playful, which you ruled out.
options.kept: Palette law: each colour has one meaning.

options.label: Drawcord Cape
options.thesis: One cord pulled turns a flat plane into shape.
options.viewport: A flat sheet that gathers into the contact.
options.case: No link to cards or halls; the metaphor would need explaining.
options.risk: Fashion editorial in a sales tool.

options.label: Game Boy Field
options.thesis: Four greens, tile grid, inverted selection.
options.case: Loses both axes: retro toy, unreadable card photos.

options.label: Cyclorama Dawn
options.thesis: Your day as light moving from night to morning.
options.viewport: Follow-ups as bands brightening through the day.
options.case: Atmospheric, not operational; colour carries too much meaning.
options.kept: Discrete named phases, never colour alone.

canonCard.label: The category standard
canonCard.thesis: Covve and HiHello's calm grey lists and white cards, executed impeccably (today's look).
canonCard.viewport: Count tiles, a grouped list, a floating Scan pill.
canonCard.risk: Indistinguishable from the competition by design.
